x: We are indeed proud to record the outstanding achievement of Stan Vickers in outclassing the best walkers in Europe to win the gold medal at Stockholm in the European 20 kilos.
Stan won it in 13:02, Ken did 13:09 and I reached the finish in 13:51 - therefore 30,000 people could get out to the tea huts in 42 seconds!
It was good to see another Davies family supporting the lads, Stan (up to town from Suffolk) and Dai. Paul Pringle was unlucky to finish a few seconds over the 3 hours mark.

Firstly, Stan's brother almost ran over a black cat en route to the White City and this led Stan to shout "We've got it". A very worried brother was cheered to hear that Stan meant that it was an omen for the record and not that the cat was dead!

We will always remember him for his interest in us and our family whenever we met and also, in earlier days, of his telegrams to Stan and I in Melbourne and the dinner he helped to arrange for the pair of us, plus Ranjit Bhatia, in Rome.
Stan Davies (1914-2002) It is with much sadness that we have to announce the death of Stan Davies, who died on the 25th September 2002 from a heart attack, aged 88 years.
